title: $F$-nilpotence and Hodge filtrations beyond isolated singularities
summary: We give Hodge-theoretic characterizations of characteristic-zero varieties of open $F$-nilpotent and open weakly $F$-nilpotent type, extending a result of Srinivas and Takagi beyond isolated singularities. We prove one direction unconditionally and the converse assuming the weak ordinarity conjecture.
